purpose: Define the smallest safe first cloud-side raw copy slice that moves GoldRush from placeholders toward source-backed audio, scene metadata, player assets, and world props without claiming promotion or creating partial receipts locally.

preCopySequence.workerAction: Read the source-access proof and handoff, then restate the source roots, source head SHA, expected products, and why each domain is being copied.
List candidate paths cloud-side using the allowlist hints and source roots, but do not copy denied folders or complete third-party plugin packs.
mustProduceBeforeCopy: candidate path list grouped by firstCopyDomains

preCopySequence.workerAction: Run deny-path and secret checks before raw copy. Findings may include redacted paths and finding types only.
Copy approved raw candidates into the destination raw import branch and produce every required receipt in the same branch.
mustProduceBeforeCopy: copy ledger entry per copied file

firstCopyDomains.reason: The browser currently uses procedural fallback tones; actual music and SFX are the highest-value parity slice and directly address the placeholder audio blocker.
edgeCases: Unity AudioSource references may point to clips by GUID, so scene and prefab metadata may be needed to name the right cue.
Loop points, mixer bus intent, and volume curves must be preserved as metadata if available.
If a file is proprietary, third-party, or license-unclear, record it as blocked instead of promoting a procedural fallback as source parity.

firstCopyDomains.reason: Both old versions must become one game; scene layout metadata is needed to map main menu, lobby, arena, classic combat, and classic solo flows.
edgeCases: Scene YAML is source data only and must not become a runtime import.
Missing GUID dependencies must be recorded in classification rather than silently replaced.
Photon, Fusion, plugin, ProjectSettings, and package dependency references must be denied or summarized without copying denied files.

firstCopyDomains.reason: The current character is a procedural prototype; player rig, weapon, animator, and combat animation candidates are needed for over-the-shoulder combat readability.
edgeCases: Animator controllers are mapping sources only; their state names and parameters should become metadata, not browser logic.
C# player controllers may be summarized into behavior facts, but C# files must not be copied as runtime code.
If rigs differ between modern and classic sources, preserve both candidates and let review choose one runtime target.

firstCopyDomains.reason: The world still relies on generated props; mines, towns, train, cactus, fences, gold, and coins are the first source-backed object vocabulary needed for the unified canyon space.
edgeCases: Do not copy entire asset-store or plugin packs when only one source-backed prop is needed.
If the train is split across engine, car, wheel, track, and material files, preserve dependency edges in the copy ledger.
Terrain meshes and materials must be classified as visual references; Nexus terrain collider remains owned by local terrain kits until conversion proves otherwise.

acceptanceForCloudWorkerBranch: No local clone of the legacy source repos is required or assumed.
All copied candidates stay under raw/imported/goldrush-dual-source-001/.
All six receipt files exist in the same branch as copied raw candidates.
node tools/validation/validate-cloud-asset-receipts.mjs --require-receipts passes on the import branch.
npm run check passes on the import branch.
The branch does not edit public/assets, approved asset registry, or runtime imports before conversion, provenance, and human review.
